_comment: Curriculum tags per concept id (WP3.1). Generated by tools/curriculum/tag_lexicon.py; do not edit by hand. curriculumBand 초급/중급/고급 = 1-2/3-4/5-6급 of the standard curriculum word list; curriculumGrade is an estimate inside the band. Sources and terms: tools/curriculum/README.txt.
